description: Earth Jukebox lets anyone hear our planet. Pick a region on the map, choose a phenomenon (wildfires, rainfall, temperature) and press play: real NASA Earth observation data becomes music, synchronized with a live animation on the map. Value sets pitch, intensity sets volume, event frequency sets rhythm. Then switch worlds: the same data is replayed with the sound character of the Moon, Mars or Jupiter, based on gravity. Data you can see, and now hear.
